ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows the terrain of Henan Province and the distribution of four types of specialized villages: in the legend of the left figure, black dots are apple planting, and black triangles are flower planting; in the legend of the right figure, squares are vegetable planting, and asterisks are tea planting. In the left figure, it can be seen that the black triangles of flower planting are relatively concentrated in the central, eastern, and southern plains/low-altitude areas of Henan, while apple points are more often seen in the west, north, and other places. In the right figure, tea asterisks are mainly in the southern mountainous area, and vegetable squares are distributed relatively widely. Reasoning: the plain areas in central and eastern Henan are densely populated and have relatively abundant labor resources; in the figure, the specialized villages most clearly connected with these labor-rich plain areas are flower-planting specialized villages. Therefore, abundant labor resources are conducive to the formation of flower specialized villages.

method.method_draft: Describe the map and legend, locate each symbol type, and focus on which type is most associated with the populous plain areas. Since the flower-village triangles cluster in the central/eastern lowland belt where labor resources are abundant, infer that abundant labor favors the formation of 花卉专业村.
